csv_project_name: Consultant for Managed Lane E-ZPass Planning Study
csv_scope_of_work: This study will evaluate the E-ZPass Express Lane system in the Twin Cities metropolitan area. It will evaluate and prioritize corridors with the best potential to benefit from E-ZPass lanes. It will also complete a benefit/cost analysis for implementing license plate tolling and automated occupancy verification systems on Minnesota s E-ZPass system.
